notes.title: Rogue Summoner Release
notes.notes:
Rogue Summoner is the newest game from Dan and Tiago Zaidan - Eliosi's Hunt's Creators!
And Rogue Summoner has just been released into the world! Go get it while it's hot. :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

[previewyoutube=-OJ-4xKp8HE;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]All about Rogue Summoner[/h2]

Rogue Summoner is a roguelike about summoning creatures to fight for you.
It's a unique blend between turn-based tactics, roguelikes, strategy, auto battlers and even chess!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25477513/9984c3fc5dd6886397e7d8f4709d0495d0bdc4a1.gif[/img]

After you create your strategy, the enemies will do their move, then, your creatures, each according to their behavior.
To become a Rogue Summoner you must master each monster's behavior and use them creatively in combat.

Check out this developer commentary video:

[previewyoutube=y-6dhXdG98s;full][/previewyoutube]


Enjoy!

Dan and Tiago Zaidan

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

notes.title: Update #4: Infinite flamethrower, Eizlazir death and more
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

This update fixes a bug where Eizlazir would die but the level wouldn't end (thanks @br.macena for letting me know!) and a bug where the flamethrower wound't use any ammo... :P

I also fixed a problem in which some weapons weren't correctly using the Controller Vibration slider option created in Update #2!

There is only until tomorrow for you (and your friends) to get Eliosi's Hunt with the discounted price, so make sure to get is quickly! :D

Thanks!!

notes.title: Update #3: moved the prerequisite installers to Steam
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

The prerequisite installers (DirectX, C++ redistributables and such) were not working correctly on some computers, so I removed them from the game and made Steam install them.
Thanks @paregonta777 for pointing this issue out. Hopefully this patch fixes @Dio's problem as well.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update #2: Set the controller vibration and reset key bindings
notes.notes:
Another update for you bounty hunters!

This time, I created a slider for the Controller Vibration (force feedback) in the Options>General menu, so players can turn it off (or make it vibrate twice as strongly!!) :D
Thanks @Metal Bay G2 for suggesting that! Agora jogar Eliosi's Hunt não vai te obrigar a comprar mais pilhas... hehehe

I also added a "Reset Keys" button in that menu so players can go back to the default keys options without having to mess with the saved files.

I hope you all have a great experience playing the game!
Cheers!

notes.title: Update #1!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

I hope you are having a great time with Eliosi's Hunt! :D

In this first update, we fixed several things in the key rebinding options on the Options/General screen.

There was a weird behavior in which an unassigned key would be activated when any key was pressed and the gamepad selection mechanism was really glitchy. This made the game unplayable for some.

Now, you should be able to easily set assign new keys by clicking on the key and pressing a new one (or moving to a key with the gamepad and pressing A (on the xbox controller) and then press a new button to assign). If you use a key that is already in use, the old key will turn red.

All players that had problems with that in the first game version should be able to fix it now. But if you do need to reset the binding (because there is no reset button yet), you can see the instructions in this discussion: http://steamcommunity.com/app/494700/discussions/0/2579854400735713323/

Special thanks to Hanuo and Gamechamp for pointing out this issue in the discussions!

Just a quick reminder, the launch discount ends this Tuesday so made sure to buy or tell your friends to buy the game quickly! :D

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Demo Update: Bug fixes and improved shaders
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We really hope you are enjoying our demo! Did anyone play the secret game mode yet? :)

We are dropping this quick update on the demo to fix some bugs; including a weird background on the upgrade screen, the controller disconnected message and an infinite vibration on the Xbox One controller (that was actually a pretty fun bug).

We also improved some shaders on the level (most notably, the swampy water). Thanks to Leonardo from Bad Minions and Marcelo from Gilp for the shader tips! ;)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25477513/3d20c98cb70a08714ebbd5c16c4ef0e7542a8371.jpg[/img]

If you like the game, please share it with your friends! :D
Thanks!

notes.title: Eliosi's Hunt Kickstarter campaign and Demo Update
notes.notes:
Our Kickstarter begins tomorrow!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25477513/e55f11f49d0f02490e6404f2a0b57c68af87cfe6.jpg[/img]

In preparation, we made a patch fixing bugs and changing some details in the Demo.

Changelog:
New features:
- Jetpack fuel is now shown in the middle of the screen
- Now you can dash before AND after activating the Jetpack
- Flamethrower’s new animations on water and with the Jetpack
- Automatic zoom out when you find the first Drone Part

Interface
Upgrade Screen:
- Clear and Apply buttons are locked when you can’t use them
- Yellow Linear Dodge is now gone
- Grenade Count is locked
- Dark Background
- Blue Confirm Button

Main Menu:
- Eliosi’s position changed

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where checkpoints would still be yellow even after activating them
- Fixed a bug where the speed feedback don’t update correctly in the HUD
- Fixed a bug where Eliosi kept aiming up to shoot the eggs after the second checkpoint
- Dash with Jetpack doesn’t require fuel
- Lady Swamp’s animation will not bug when you burn her with the flamethrower
- The Jetpack name appears on the HUD
- Second Dash now changes it’s color when full
- We reviewed the Portuguese text
